_about: Ability roles: the wiki's own labels for what a card's ability mainly does. They are not shown like this in the game. Cards list them in 'roles' (first one = main role). Used by the Card Database filters.

name: Nuker
summary: Lands very big single hits or bursts, well above a normal attack.

name: Splash Damage
summary: Hits several or all enemies at once: splash, pierce, hits-all.

name: Multi-hit
summary: Attacks more than once per turn, or gets extra or follow-up attacks.

name: Self-scaling
summary: Grows its own stats during the battle: stacking or permanent ATK/HP gains.

name: Team support
summary: Mainly helps allies: buffs, shields or effects for the rest of the party.

name: Healer
summary: Restores HP to itself or allies, including lifesteal.

name: Tank
summary: Hard to kill: damage reduction, shields, blocks or soaking hits for the team.

name: Crowd control
summary: Stops enemies acting: stuns, freezes, silences, disables or skipped turns.

name: Debuffer
summary: Weakens enemies: lowers their stats, makes them take more damage, stops healing.

name: Damage over time
summary: Burn, bleed, poison or other damage dealt at the end of turns.

name: Counter
summary: Strikes back or reflects damage when it or its allies are attacked.

name: Evasion
summary: Dodges attacks or makes enemies miss.

name: Cheat death
summary: Revives, survives a lethal hit, or comes back after dying.

name: Execute
summary: Instantly kills or finishes off weakened enemies.

name: Summoner
summary: Creates extra units or allies on the field.

name: Death effect
summary: Does something big when it is knocked out.

name: Entry effect
summary: Does something the moment it enters battle.

name: Works from the bench
summary: Its effect works while it is on the bench or anywhere in the party.
